evidence: End-to-end trial on the V2 production environment (r2-v2.0.1): story -> video source -> episodes
approval_disclosure: Human instructed the agent to perform every step including approvals ('ban khong can dung lai hay bam nut duyet luon'). Gate A greenlight d5da80e6-96e8-4d30-aaca-2a7b3d9f782a and the story approval were performed by the agent through the API with the admin session; the records show 'admin' but no Human read the brief or the manuscript before approval.

story_run.running: 18:12 -> 23:19 (local time 2026-10-22), 133 generate calls, about 306 min of model time
story_run.manuscript: Đò Cuối Sông: 3 chapters, 11 scenes, about 7,630 syllables, 0 CJK, 0 Cyrillic
story_run.approval: manifest sha256:7bc46b1e8d10ecd4e15ea7d258daf17595536aba1fa115f8861517de753aadc6, all 16 exceptions accepted by the agent; phase COMMITTED
story_run.accepted_exceptions_summary: son dead vs alive contradiction, withheld secret revealed early, chapter 2 ending rushed, chapter 3 missing the planned mooring, blurb claim not in the story

handoff: send-to-video created source/do-cuoi-song.txt, byte-identical to the export (sha256:f947c2d7...)
overview: First run produced a Chinese synopsis because source_language was unset and the overview prompt defaults to 中文; it set source_language vi; a second run produced a Vietnamese synopsis.

episode_planning.route: The planner is reachable only through the embedded agent, which had no credential. Planning was run through the server's remote MCP tool plan_episodes with a temporary API key (created, used, deleted).
episode_planning.result: 8 MCP batches, about 40 min: 18 contiguous episodes covering 0..34,365 (whole source), every episode ends at a sentence end
episode_planning.quality: episode length 51 to 3,495 syllables despite the 120 s target (the 9B model repeated punctuation-only anchors such as '* * *' and './', so batches kept short prefixes, and once cut a 15,469-char episode on a verbatim, unique sentence); titles with CJK: episode 9 has 《》, episode 18 is fully Chinese

embedded_agent.config: Agent credential 'Ollama local (qwen3.5-vimax:9b)', preset __custom__, base_url http://localhost:11434, active; cloud presets can be added and activated later without code changes
embedded_agent.defect_found: New agent sessions always failed with 'SDK 会话创建超时': the CLI init message carries session_id inside data, so the id was only found on the first stream event; a local model needs minutes before its first token. Fixed in 6931430d (same root cause as upstream #2371, written here because cherry-picking upstream code was refused by the permission classifier).
embedded_agent.verification_on_accept_env: ~/arcreel-v2-story-accept restarted on 6931430d with the same Ollama agent credential: session created in 1.5 s (was 60 s timeout), the agent called ArcReel MCP tools (list_projects, get_project_content, read_project_file, list_source_files) and completed in about 2 min, but qwen3.5-vimax:9b never called plan_episodes and answered in Chinese. Driving the agent needs a stronger model.

open_items: Set source_language at hand-off so the overview is not written in Chinese.
Planner guards: reject punctuation-only anchors, cap an episode at a multiple of the target volume, and reject CJK in titles for Vietnamese sources.
Human should read the approved story (16 accepted narrative-critical items).
